meta.title: Our Sponsors · IGC 2026
meta.description: Meet the partners behind IGC 2026, The Supernaturals: Crystal Klair, Katonium, TEEQUAD, Medaan Engineering and Crimson and Connect.

intro.title: Our Sponsors
intro.lead: The businesses and organisations standing with the Issachar Generation to make IGC 2026 possible. Get to know what each of them does.

sponsors.name: Crystal Klair Glamour Touch Limited
sponsors.tagline: Your one-stop shop for building finishing.
sponsors.quote: We bring your dream building to reality.
sponsors.bannerAlt: Stacked tiles, a granite slab, a white panel door and a freestanding bathtub.
sponsors.about: An exclusive one-stop building materials company offering high-quality products and reliable service, with innovative, cost-effective, sustainable building solutions.

items.label: Vision
items.text: To be a leading brand providing durable, quality yet affordable building and construction support services that promote a sustainable future within Nigeria and West Africa.

items.label: Mission
items.text: To provide premium services that enhance corporate integrity and guarantee customer satisfaction and trust, through quality yet affordable, cost-effective building solutions.

items.title: APLUS SIGNATURE Nigeria Limited
items.text: Business planning, strategy and execution, and construction services.

items.title: Helvic Nigeria Limited
items.text: Waterproofing, insulation and acoustic panels, sport flooring and decorative walls.

locations: Beside Supernovae Mega Mart, off Linda Chalker Street, Guzape, Abuja
find.note: Serves all 36 states and the wider West African region.

sponsors.name: Katonium Concepts Limited
sponsors.tagline: Smart technology, security and connectivity for a safer, smarter and more connected world.
sponsors.bannerAlt: A Wi-Fi router, CCTV camera and recorder, a Starlink dish and a solar panel with controller.
sponsors.about: A technology and security company providing ICT, physical security, networking, power and connectivity solutions for homes, businesses, offices and organizations. It handles design, supply, installation and maintenance.

items.label: Mission
items.text: To provide accessible, reliable and innovative technology and security solutions that solve real-world problems.

blocks.title: Approach
blocks.text: Complete solutions from assessment and product selection through installation, configuration and after-sales support.

sponsors.name: TEEQUAD Global Services Ltd.
sponsors.tagline: Integrated travel, logistics, corporate support and facility management.
sponsors.bannerAlt: A passport and boarding pass, a model aircraft, a delivery truck with a GPS tracker, a document folder and cleaning supplies.
sponsors.about: An operational partner that helps organizations handle complex support functions so they can focus on their core business.

items.title: Travel and tourism
items.text: Flights, hotels, ticketing, visas, travel management and VIP protocol.

items.title: Logistics and haulage
items.text: Fleet management, vehicle tracking, haulage and supply chain.

items.title: Corporate services
items.text: Business registration, documentation, procurement and executive support.

items.title: Facility management
items.text: Technical maintenance, cleaning and professional security.

items.label: Mission
items.text: Adaptable, high-impact facility and logistical solutions that ensure client satisfaction year after year.

items.label: Vision
items.text: To become a global benchmark for integrated corporate support services.

locations: Shop B16-11, Karu Community Plaza, Karu Market, Abuja

sponsors.name: Medaan Engineering Services Limited
sponsors.tagline: Engineering solutions that keep industry moving.
sponsors.bannerAlt: A hydraulic power unit, a refrigeration compressor, an electrical control panel, safety gloves and a hard hat.
sponsors.about: An integrated engineering company, incorporated in 2016, combining engineering expertise, quality equipment, trusted OEM partnerships and field execution. One partner, from challenge to completion.

locations: G.O.P Mall, Plot 6, Nyanya–Jikwoyi Road, Karu Layout, Abuja
find.note: Offices also in Lagos and Port Harcourt.

sponsors.name: Crimson and Connect Empowerment Initiative
sponsors.bannerAlt: School notebooks and a backpack, a sewing machine with fabric, freshly baked bread and a laptop.
sponsors.about: A youth-led organization ensuring every child, with or without disability, can reach their potential. It is built on more than five years of hands-on work with in-school and out-of-school children.

items.label: Vision
items.text: An Africa where every child has access to quality education, skills to earn a living, and the confidence to lead.

items.label: Mission
items.text: To reach marginalized children, especially out-of-school children and adolescent girls, with learning, life skills and livelihood opportunities.

items.title: Education and Safe Spaces
items.text: The Crimson and Connect Education Project, for ages 10–18, covering literacy, numeracy, life skills, SRHR, mental health and bodily autonomy.

items.title: Vocational Skills Training
items.text: Fashion, baking and digital skills, with internships for top trainees.

items.title: Youth Leadership
items.text: Peer-to-peer workshops and platforms such as the Fail Fun Conference in Abuja.

blocks.title: Approach
blocks.text: Individualized learning plans, working with parents, community and religious leaders, mentors and partners.

blocks.title: Where they work
blocks.text: Federal Capital Territory (Abuja), including Kwali Area Council, with plans to expand to other states.
